blocks.text: 2. Defining Principle: Language, Music, and Code Are One System

Era Zero is not ordinary speech with musical decoration and not a programming language hidden inside music. The music is the code. A DBA utterance is a structured semantic object that can be heard as language, performed as music, evaluated as logic, executed as software, stored as data, and transcribed as writing without translating into a second representational system.
A normal complete unit carries these layers:
• Melodic contour: utterance or programming function.
• Timing and vocal register: relationships and participant roles.
• Runtime state ending: current status 0, 1, or 2/num.
Family and address form an unambiguous machine identity such as LIF:111 or MOV:020. Human transliteration and musical realization are generated representations of that identity.
